where: heading of Proposition 1.3, reference in parentheses

scan: 1.7.6 with the digit 1 (the same digit as in '1.3'); p. 3 writes '[H] II.7.17' with letters
note: Hartshorne's Residues and Duality numbers its chapters in roman numerals; the equivalent conditions for injective dimension are I.7.6. The TeX keeps the printed '1.7.6'. p. 6 prints the same '[H] 1.7.6' (s5.tex line 406): correct both or neither in the corrected edition. Only a digit for a roman numeral, so optional.
